Core Architectural Mechanism

Three Steps of Mechanical Verification

Unlike conversational LLMs that guess solutions, Bartholomew guarantees deterministic correctness through a closed-loop verification engine.

Step 1 — Isolate and Reproduce

Clones the failing commit into a fully isolated sandbox and synthesizes a standalone reproduction script that proves the defect is real.

Step 2 — Minimal AST Patch

Applies a surgical compiler-level AST patch strictly addressing the root-cause failure with zero collateral changes to surrounding code.

Step 3 — 100% Verification

Executes the full test suite locally to prove 100% green passes with zero regressions before any Pull Request is opened.
